samples: This program fetches all customer records from a paginated API by following cursor links across multiple pages, then groups the customers by country and prints a sorted count of how many customers are in each country. It demonstrates cursor-based pagination handling and data aggregation. The module would be useful if you need to retrieve and analyze customer distribution across countries from an API that returns results in pages.
